project_type: Python CLI security toolkit (bug bounty arsenal)
test_framework: No formal test framework - CLI --dry-run and --help for validation
verification_instructions: 1. Run python -m super_monster --help to verify CLI works. 2. Run python -m super_monster scan --target example.com --dry-run to verify dry-run mode works without network. 3. Verify all imports resolve correctly.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode - full access available. Python 3.11 default.
contribution_requirements: Pure Python + colorama only. No external tool dependencies. Module runnable via python -m super_monster.
key_patterns: Uses colorama for terminal colors with fallback to empty strings. Module entry via __main__.py calling main(). CLI uses argparse with subcommands. Each module is self-contained with clear docstrings.
directory_structure: Bug-Bounty/ root with monster/, super_monster/, apk_analyzer/ as peer tools. Each tool is a Python package with __main__.py entry point.
